mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly FEDFUNDS rate above the prior 12-month average precedes a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return as investors anticipate tighter credit conditions.
failure_condition: Over 60-day window, no significant negative returns after FEDFUNDS crosses above 12-month average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising monthly PAYEMS relative to INDPRO indicates strengthening labor demand, which is associated with positive 5-day S&P 500 forward returns as firms expand hiring.
failure_condition: Over 100 observations, the 5-day return is not statistically different from zero (p > 0.05) when labor demand is expanding.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly surge in HOUST (household spending) above the 6-month moving average predicts a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as consumer confidence drives equity valuation expansion.
failure_condition: 60-day returns remain flat or negative despite sustained HOUST growth (Rank IC < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in INDPRO below the 3-month moving average signals supply-side weakness, which is associated with negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns as market anticipates profit compression.
failure_condition: No significant negative returns when INDPRO remains below 3-month average for 40 consecutive months (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive monthly CPIAUCSL prints above the 10-period simple average indicate persistent inflation pressure, which is linked to negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns as investors anticipate rate hikes.
failure_condition: Over 200 instances, no negative returns when CPIAUCSL stays above 10-period SMA (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in UNRATE below 4% over the next 3 months is expected to produce positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns as lower labor-force participation supports market optimism.
failure_condition: No positive 60-day returns when UNRATE remains below 4% for 3 months without subsequent positive 20-day moves (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in GDPC1 (GDP) and PAYEMS above their respective 4-week moving averages suggest robust demand, which is associated with positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Over 500 instances, no positive 5-day return when both proxies exceed their 4-week averages (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A prolonged decline in RSAFS (available for sale) below the 12-month average indicates excess supply, which is expected to produce negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns as investors anticipate further market corrections.
failure_condition: Over 300 months, no negative 20-day returns when RSAFS stays below 12-month average (p > 0.05).
